description: Header file defining the AudioTimeStretcher class, which buffers and transforms audio data using WSOLA algorithm for playback speed adjustments. It includes method declarations for initialization, buffering, reading, and WSOLA processing, along with private members for managing audio buffers and processing state.

classes.name: AudioTimeStretcher
classes.description: Class for buffering and time-stretching audio data using WSOLA algorithm, supporting initialization, buffer management, and audio processing for variable playback speeds.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the object with audio stream info: sample type, channels, and samples per second.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Attempts to fill requested frames into destination buffer, possibly scaled by playback rate.

methods.name: EnqueueBuffer
methods.description: Enqueues a decoded audio buffer for processing.

methods.name: IsQueueFull
methods.description: Checks if the internal buffer queue is full.

methods.name: frames_buffered
methods.description: Returns the number of frames currently buffered.

methods.name: GetOptimalBlock
methods.description: Finds the most similar data block within search region for WSOLA.

methods.name: WriteCompletedFramesTo
methods.description: Writes completed frames from WSOLA output to destination buffer.

methods.name: PeekAudioWithZeroPrepend
methods.description: Fills destination with audio frames, allowing negative offset with zero prepend.

methods.name: RunOneWsolaIteration
methods.description: Performs one iteration of WSOLA processing if enough data is available.

methods.name: RemoveOldInputFrames
methods.description: Advances buffer to remove frames no longer needed.

methods.name: UpdateOutputTime
methods.description: Updates current output time based on playback rate and time change.

methods.name: TargetIsWithinSearchRegion
methods.description: Checks if target block is within search region.

methods.name: CanPerformWsola
methods.description: Checks if enough data exists to run WSOLA.

methods.name: ConvertMillisecondsToFrames
methods.description: Converts milliseconds to frame count based on sample rate.
